markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (42%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged reliability on a simulated frozen section and near-tied InSitu/Invasive probabilities warrant recut, deeper levels, and deferred margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 42%, Invasive 40%, Benign 18%, Normal 0% [F1] (ECE 5%, n=132) | InSitu and Invasive nearly tied |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Three classes unseparated at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 22% (flagged), OOD 78% [F6] (error AUROC 70%) | Suspect input; lower model trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 (80%) InSitu [F5]; closest BACH_0273 Invasive (91%) | Neighbors favor InSitu; closest Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 0, 1, 4) · context · Above typical (contribution -0.76) [F2]; AI spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Above typical (contribution +0.71) [F3]; AI spot check 19/20 · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical (contribution -0.29) [F4]; caption mismatch, spot check 18/20 · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Contribution +0.23, but AI spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Contribution +0.21, but AI spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), normal lobules (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section quality (reliability 22%, OOD 78%) distorts morphology; drafted orders request a recut and deeper levels.
- Stromal invasion in regions 0, 1, 3 is true invasive carcinoma (40%), matching neighbor BACH_0273 (91% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 3, 4**: Verify stromal invasion versus lymphocyte-rich in situ lesion (tile risk 92%–97%).
2. **Regions 5, 6**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (100% risk), where unreliable necrosis and mitoses scores peak.
3. **Regions 8, 9, 10**: Confirm low-risk tubules and duct-confined atypia (0% risk); defer margins.
